title: Integrated AlphaHoldem two-seed two-million-hand scale
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The ordinary integrated replay/loss-K-best/adaptive-league recipe has a reproducible positive long-horizon learning slope beyond one million actual hands; exact-state continuation of both independent lineages to 2,097,152 hands will retain Standard10 capability and improve broad frozen performance on average across seeds, even if individual early endpoints remain noisy.
material_change: Continue the clean Seed1 and Seed2 one-million checkpoints independently to 2,097,152 actual environment hands with the identical ordinary Trinal-Clip PPO recipe, optimizer, two-generation replay, adaptive league, pool, and source KL. Use disjoint fixed-deal windows, archive every 64 iterations, then evaluate both frozen 2M endpoints versus their own 1M parents on untouched four-anchor both-seat panels.
baseline: Cross-seed 262k-to-1M matched slope +2.4887 +/-3.268 bb/100 over 131,072 evaluation hands; Seed1 +2.7245, Seed2 +2.2529. Standard10 anchor mean -2.8473 and seat1 mean -0.3121 remain weaknesses, while both Standard10 drift audits pass.
source: Seed1 clean 1M SHA256 6fbbe021b140b91e448917ae3e2cbb9bcdca444865433074ac944cae79fa844a at 1,049,269 actual hands; Seed2 clean 1M SHA256 b5602618ec0501698aa22231b6c0e945da75ee3daf2c408e3eac2bb802702558 at 1,048,795 actual hands.

notes: This is a geometric scale experiment, not a short smoke. Stop only for explicit health/accounting/replay/trust-region failure. Endpoint admission uses cross-seed slope, four-anchor and both-seat breadth, Standard10 preservation, and raw evidence; a noisy individual endpoint is not a method rejection.

Both 1M sources passed all nine resume gates. Seed1/Seed2 assignment chains have 220 exact records; optimizer, two replay generations, five-entry pool, adaptive league and physical accounting are serialized. New deal starts 24.1M/25.1M exceed the respective first-unused upper bounds 16.1685M/17.1698M.

Both 14400-second training processes stopped cleanly with exit code 0. Final checkpoint accounting is seed1=2098423 and seed2=2070929 actual environment hands. Resume preflight now restores the serialized dynamic five-opponent pool rather than assuming the initial three-opponent pool, proves fresh worker deal windows above conservative prior cursors, verifies serialized two-iteration PPO replay, optimizer steps, adaptive league state, and assignment RNG evidence. Seed1 already satisfies target and is frozen; only Seed2 requires a minimal exact-state continuation.

Seed2 recovery uses the same config, seeds, run id, optimizer, replay, adaptive league, and assignment evidence; only the fixed deal start moves to a preflight-proven fresh non-overlapping window. No reset flags are used.

The first audit intentionally remains as evidence of two outdated gate assumptions: a valid pending assignment after max-runtime and append-only logs across in-place resume. The v2 audit accepts only cryptographically replayed pending tails and exact contiguous resume suffixes; it passes all gates for both runs.

The 2M endpoints preserve Standard10 action distributions but regress specifically and reproducibly in seat0. Across 32768 independent matched pairs the pooled 2M-minus-1M CI is entirely negative by a narrow margin; Standard10 and seat0 CIs are also entirely negative. This is explicit multi-seed mechanism evidence against scaling the unchanged recipe, while not rejecting learned self-play or longer training under a corrected objective.

result.summary: Continued two independent integrated AlphaHoldem lineages from approximately 1M to at least 2.097M actual environment hands with exact optimizer, serialized replay, dynamic league, assignment RNG, and fresh deal-stream continuity. Both training and 20k Standard10 preservation audits passed. Fresh four-anchor matched evaluation over 131072 hands found a replicated 2M-minus-1M regression: pooled -3.2402 +/-3.1547 bb/100, Standard10 -9.0302 +/-6.7912, and seat0 -7.9224 +/-5.6990.
result.conclusion: The hypothesis of continued positive long-horizon slope for the unchanged replay/loss-kbest/adaptive-league recipe is rejected. The earlier 262k-to-1M gain was real, but the learning curve turns over by 2M; source KL preserves global action proximity yet does not prevent opponent-seat-specific degradation. Evidence supports retaining the approximately 1M checkpoints as stronger candidates and changing the objective or checkpoint-selection mechanism before additional scale.
result.next_step: Run a fresh matched archive turning-point audit at the existing approximately 1.3M and 1.58M checkpoints across both seeds to localize onset of seat0 and Standard10 regression without new training. Use the result to choose between early-stopped checkpoint selection and a seat-balanced self-play or opponent-league correction; do not spend 4M hands on the unchanged recipe.
